Charge in the cheapest hours before you leave

When the car is plugged in at home, the bridge moves tonight\'s charging to the cheapest hours before you need the car, using the car\'s own charge timer (2014–2017 cars, spot price). With \"full charge\" set, the car keeps charging past the window until it\'s full, and your own timer is put back in the morning. Switch this off to put your timer back at once (when the car is in reach). New: keep an eye on the first nights.
